evidence.reason: The reconciliation treats a matching PR head plus a merge commit that is merely an ancestor of the target as sufficient to record remediation as fixed. A conflict-resolving merge can retain the unfixed base content while still having the published head and an ancestor merge commit, so line 817 can credit remediation and line 818 can set `remediation_state='fixed'` without checking that the merge tree actually contains the repair. This is an ordinary correctness defect, not a new requirement; add merge-tree containment validation or require revalidation before recording the fixed outcome.
